label: Cedar Hollow
name: Cedar Hollow Community Church
about: Cedar Hollow began as a Bible study of eleven families meeting in a farmhouse on Quillmore Lane. Our current building was finished in 1981 and expanded in 2009 to add the Fellowship Hall and children's wing.
first_visit: Services last about an hour. Dress is casual; you will see everything from jeans to suits. Greeters at the front doors can show you around, and coffee and pastries are in the lobby before each service.
